objective: Implement the production synthetic execution timeline and deterministic render tests exactly as frozen in docs/CR5D_INITIAL_WORKER_UI_CONTRACT.md section 2.
semanticAcceptance: The component matches contract section 2, preserves supplied event order, and distinguishes progress, checkpoints, completion, and cancellation without inventing lifecycle state.
Render tests cover every event kind, an empty timeline, applicable event fields, semantic ordered-list structure, deterministic output, and safe text escaping.
The implementation performs no sorting, polling, retry, cancellation, time calculation, state mutation, effect, or dashboard integration.
stopConditions: Stop if the contract requires editing any path outside allowedPaths or importing a not-yet-integrated worker module.
Stop before changing CSS, dashboard pages, backend routes, domain state, policy, protocol, persistence, dependencies, or architecture.
Stop before any install, download, native command, service, credential access, external effect, or production mutation.
